'''Mole''' was a renegade [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who tried to defect to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after escaping from [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] clutches. He was then sought after by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] on a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]].

==Biography==
===In Hiding===
Mole eventually retreated to the world of [[Ota]]. He was then found by Boba Fett when he and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] crash-landed on the planet and were captured by the [[Snogar]] people. He escaped with Luke Skywalker, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] into the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
